title: racosperma ophiolithicum
intro: Racosperma ophiolithicum, commonly known as "Bitter Acacia", is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. The plant is used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from digestive issues and diabetes due to its potential to lower blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Bitter Acacia include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Racosperma ophiolithicum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
